contentText: PRESS REVIEW – Friday, January 9: The French papers look at the industries that could benefit from the EU's free trade deal with South America. The Mercosur deal is set to pass in a vote in Brussels. Also, a new report shows overdose deaths from fentanyl are declining and it could be thanks to China's crackdown on the sale of precursor chemicals. Plus, the mayor of Berlin is in hot water over a tennis match he played while the city was in a power blackout.
